ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 95% of the visible fluke surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity white pixels localized only to distal tips and small focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey to black pigmentation across the majority of both lobes; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips; two isolated white circular points positioned vertically near the central midline above the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 92 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary; trailing edge exhibits a series of peaks and valleys with higher amplitude and frequency on the distal half of the left lobe relative to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave trajectory curving from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of white circular pixels concentrated at the lateral termination points of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with localized biofouling.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct high-intensity white circular marks near the center of the fluke; significant barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of the trailing edge.
